name: What does a log and cabin finish upgrade typically include?

mainEntity.name: What does a log and cabin finish upgrade typically include?

acceptedAnswer.text: A log and cabin finish upgrade includes restoring and refining both interior and exterior wood surfaces, paired with interior remodeling. For the wood structures, this covers cleaning, light surface prep, staining, clear-coat sealing, and chinking or caulking touch-ups. Inside the cabin, upgrades frequently expand into finish carpentry, custom framing, interior painting, drywall repairs, and updated tile or trim around hearths and kitchens. Working with a general contractor who handles both structural finishes and interior trade work ensures that moisture seals, decorative woodwork, and living spaces are updated together rather than through disconnected contractors.
acceptedAnswer.description: A log and cabin finish upgrade includes wood prep, staining, sealing, and chinking repairs, along with interior finish carpentry, drywall, painting, and tile work.
